name: Neurodegeneration with Brain Iron Accumulation

criteria.description: Evidence of brain iron accumulation on MRI, especially in the globus pallidus and substantia nigra
Progressive extrapyramidal symptoms including dystonia, parkinsonism, and spasticity
Identification of pathogenic variants in NBIA-associated genes (e.g., PANK2, PLA2G6)
Characteristic 'eye of the tiger' sign on T2-weighted MRI

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of clinical features consistent with NBIA plus MRI evidence of brain iron accumulation; genetic confirmation supports diagnosis but is not mandatory.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic heterogeneity exists; some patients may lack typical MRI findings early in disease.

searchTerms: involuntary twisting face and mouth movements
abnormal muscle contractions in orofacial area

pathognomonic.symptomName: Parkinsonism features including bradykinesia and rigidity
Characteristic 'eye of the tiger' sign on brain MRI
pathognomonic.notes: Radiological finding pathognomonic for PANK2-associated NBIA
searchTerms: brain MRI showing central bright spot in globus pallidus
characteristic brain imaging sign with central hyperintensity
progressive night blindness and tunnel vision
optic nerve wasting leading to vision problems

occasional.symptomName: Psychiatric manifestations including depression and anxiety

laboratory: Elevated serum ferritin in some cases
imaging: T2-weighted MRI showing hypointensity in globus pallidus and substantia nigra
'Eye of the tiger' sign on MRI characteristic of PANK2 mutations
genetic: Pathogenic variants in PANK2, PLA2G6, C19orf12, and other NBIA-associated genes
other: Progressive neurodegeneration with iron accumulation confirmed by histopathology in rare biopsy/autopsy cases

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of 'eye of the tiger' MRI sign
Lack of brain iron accumulation on MRI
Autonomic failure and cerebellar signs predominant

redFlags: Rapidly progressive dystonia in childhood or early adulthood
Characteristic MRI findings of brain iron accumulation
Early onset parkinsonism unresponsive to levodopa
references: Hayflick SJ. Neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation: diagnosis and management. J Mov Disord. 2016;9(1):1-13.
Le Ber I, et al. Consensus clinical diagnostic criteria for neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation. Neurology. 2020;95(12):e1635-e1646.
Kruer MC. Neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation: diagnosis and therapeutics. Curr Neurol Neurosci Rep. 2013;13(10):378.
